title: Reverse Burnett Problem for Einstein–Vlasov Limits
exact_target: Can every indicated Einstein--massless-Vlasov spacetime be approximated by high-frequency vacuum Einstein geometries?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003916 (OWR-16411-009). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical General Relativity (2018), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2018/36, pp. 2157--2251. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 58.
Huneau--Luk 2024 (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The convergence gauge, local existence region and source regularity conditions are indispensable. The requested high-frequency family must solve the vacuum equations, not merely reproduce the effective stress tensor in a formal expansion.
